- **+$1,043 against the $5,500 limit** (owner raised it from $5,000 on 2026-11-27 to keep the inline roll and the review fixes). The belt roll (fallback `PIP_ROLL_DRIVE=belt`) is −$669 landed; the owner chose the inline roll for its hand-feel and slimmer shoulder.
